Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: Misidentified the target film and director. Despite the WebSurfer’s results showing “Aurora (2018 Filipino film)” directed by Yam Laranas, the Planner asserted that “Aurora (2018)” referred to the Finnish drama by Miia Tervo (which premiered in 2019). This incorrect disambiguation led the workflow to fetch Miia Tervo’s birthplace (Rovaniemi, Finland) instead of the correct director’s (Yam Laranas), resulting in the wrong final answer.
